name: @lacqjs/nuxt-maptalks-gl
description: Nuxt 4 的 maptalks-gl 模块：SSR 守卫、动态加载、map/layer 生命周期、多地图命名实例与注册表、横切 composable 与类型化图层预设。

scripts.cleanup: (pnpx nuxt cleanup || npx nuxt cleanup) && pnpx rimraf .nuxt .output dist node_modules .data
scripts.clean:install: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm run docs:cleanup && pnpm run playground:cleanup && pnpm install
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && nuxi dev playground
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxi prepare playground
scripts.docs:cleanup: pnpx rimraf docs/.nuxt docs/.output docs/dist docs/node_modules docs/.data
scripts.playground:cleanup: pnpx rimraf playground/.nuxt playground/.output playground/dist playground/node_modules
scripts.release: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm prepack && changelogen --release --no-github && git push origin dev --follow-tags && pnpm publish && changelogen gh release
scripts.release:patch: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm prepack && changelogen --release --patch --no-github && git push origin dev --follow-tags && pnpm publish && changelogen gh release
scripts.release:minor: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm prepack && changelogen --release --minor --no-github && git push origin dev --follow-tags && pnpm publish && changelogen gh release
scripts.release:major: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm prepack && changelogen --release --major --no-github && git push origin dev --follow-tags && pnpm publish && changelogen gh release
